verdict.rationale: LM Studio runs entirely on the user's own hardware: local model download and inference, offline RAG, and serving OpenAI-like endpoints on localhost or the network. It also ships llmster, a headless daemon for servers, cloud instances and CI, and a community user confirms the headless flow works with real tools. Missing for 10: the product is closed source, so users cannot build or modify their own deployment, and community reports say its license/terms forbid work use, limiting self-hosting in professional settings.
